digest.component_or_area: plan-review criterion and acceptance-criteria evidence classification
propositions: Plan review must visit every acceptance-criteria item and classify evidence kind as either codebase-verifiable or operator-attested, with criterion-specific evidence for each classification.
Externally verifiable criteria without the exact [operator-attested] tag or with malformed tags must produce findings that name the correct syntax; criteria with exact tags must be accepted.

Codebase-verifiable criteria carrying the [operator-attested] tag must produce findings explaining that ticket comments cannot substitute for repository proof; untagged codebase-verifiable criteria must be accepted.

Acceptance criteria that bundle both repository proof and outside-world proof must not be silently assigned a single evidence kind; authors must split such criteria into independently certifiable items.
High-confidence misclassification findings must participate in normal blocking policy while deterministic keyword detection remains advisory and fail-open.

The new criterion must achieve 100% precision on external negatives, 100% recall on specified fixtures, and macro precision/recall ≥0.90 across a frozen corpus with no regression of previously passing fixtures.
